products.title: Casio Edifice EFR-539L-7CVUDF White Analog Dial Brown Leather Band Men's Watch
products.short_description: A sophisticated Casio Edifice chronograph featuring a clean white analog dial, premium brown leather band, and 100-meter water resistance.
products.long_description: The Casio Edifice EFR-539L-7CVUDF (EX306) blends classic elegance with racing-inspired functionality. It features a stunning layered white dial with three functional sub-dials and high-contrast hour markers for effortless readability. The polished stainless steel case is paired with a genuine brown leather strap, providing a comfortable and professional look suitable for both boardroom and weekend wear. Built with a 1/10-second stopwatch and 100-meter water resistance, this timepiece is as practical as it is stylish.
